user_goal: Avancar a direcao visual da Splash V3 em desenvolvimento e deixar lettering legivel, cristalino e pronto para revisao futura no Mega Drive.

existing_curation.reference_implementation: Existing Splash V3 IMAGE plates at 224x48 and 192x32, composed on BG_A over the selected V006 crystal backdrop in BG_B.

technical_family.plane_model: BG_B holds the full-screen crystal backdrop; BG_A receives separate SGDK and FORGE image tilemaps; sprites carry particles and sweep.

first_tool.reason: Translate the persisted V003 direction B through aspect-preserving reduction and the VDP 9-bit palette, preserve the current plates by hash, and activate the candidate only in the isolated lab runtime.

decision.basis: The native 4bpp probes show stronger crystal identity than A while SGDK/FORGE counters remain open in this translation; C leans sporty and A is close to the current placeholder.

evidence_required: Builder report with source/runtime hashes and plate formats.
Provenance audit for all symbols in res/resources.res.
Tile residency and palette-role validation for B plates.
SGDK 2.11 wrapper build with exact flags and ROM SHA-256.
BlastEm screenshots of contour, fill, FORGE, sweep, fade and prompt for that ROM hash.
Human visual review before final pixel or model-sheet approval.
forbidden_shortcuts_until_evidence: Do not draw or repair letter silhouettes with runtime or PIL primitives.
Do not treat a contact sheet, 4bpp normalization, or selected screenshot as final art approval.
Do not change FORJA V2, canonical template, consumer projects, or final-promotion flags.
Do not claim total VRAM, stable 60fps, or final audio quality from lettering probes.
handoff_next: Submit the exact V006/B ROM and screenshot for human native-resolution review; capture BUTTON_A replay and a frame-marked full cycle, listen to two integrated audio cycles, and close performance/budget findings before any promotion.

result.candidate_status: B active WIP in isolated res paths and observed in the exact V006 ROM; not selected/approved by the user.
